system.description:
Requirements: Training (2) and Expertise (2) in Melee Weapons or Ranged Weapons, and you must receive training from a practitioner of this style, or have access to its teachings

Frost Dragon Style teaches that every technique has a flaw, every defense a crack, every body a weakness, and every mind a blind spot. The practitioner's craft is to find that moment and exploit it: a cut that comes unseen, a slip that becomes a fall, a thrust that goes between the seams of the armor. The Frost Dragon does not attack without thought; it bides its time for the perfect moment, then strikes with neither nor hesitation.

You have the patience of glaciers and the implacable will of oceans.

  • As an Action, you may enter Frost Dragon Style.

  • You have Greater Advantage on checks to move through an enemy's space.

  • You can hold your breath for twice as long.

  • Your maximum Focus is 3. When you enter Frost Dragon Style, you gain +1 Focus.

  • Build Focus: Once per turn, you may use an Action to gain +1 Focus.

  • Channel the Current: At the end of your turn, you gain +1 Focus for each of the following:

    • You inflicted a Condition on an enemy.

    • You attacked an enemy suffering from a Condition, OR you damaged an enemy as a Reaction between now and the end of your previous turn.

  • When you make an Attack Check with a Melee or Ranged weapon you may spend up to 3 Focus, before or after rolling to gain +1 bonus Expertise on that check per Focus spent.

  • If you do not spend or gain any Focus during your turn, your Focus decreases by -1 at the end of your turn.

  • If you have 0 Focus at the end of your turn, Frost Dragon Style immediately ends.

  • If you enter another Stance or if you are Incapacitated, Frost Dragon Style immediately ends.

If you choose, you may begin maintaining Frost Dragon Style before combat starts, at the cost of giving up your first Action on your first turn in combat.
